_meta.what: Rendering parameters of figure group B (Figs. 5-10 and SI figures): isovalues, colour ranges, broadenings and similar choices that are NOT results. Same schema as facts.json (value, unit, meaning, source) so that they can be merged into facts.json as fig.* keys for numbers_audit.

igmh_iso.meaning: isovalue of the IGMH inter-fragment delta-g (delta g_inter) isosurface, Fig. 5a

igmh_range.meaning: sign(lambda2)rho colour range of the IGMH isosurface (blue -> green at 0 -> red, two slopes); covers rho at the N1-H1A...O5 BCP (0.078 a.u.)

orbital_iso.meaning: orbital isovalue (+ orange, - violet) of the HOMO/LUMO renders, Fig. 7a,b

dos_window.meaning: energy window of the TDOS/PDOS panel, Fig. 7c (Multiwfn curve, FWHM facts dos.fwhm)

mep_iso.meaning: electron-density isovalue of the surface on which the MEP is mapped (Multiwfn quantitative surface analysis default), Fig. 8

mep_range.meaning: MEP colour range shared by both panels of Fig. 8 (two slopes, green at 0)

mep_label_min_abs.meaning: extrema of the ion pair with |V| below this are drawn but not labelled (Fig. 8a); every labelled value is a facts.json bulk.mep value

mep_hist_bin.meaning: bin width of the surface-area histogram of the ESP, Fig. 8c

hs_dnorm_range.meaning: d_norm colour range of the Hirshfeld surfaces (red at the minimum, white at 0, blue at the maximum; two slopes), Fig. 6a,b and SI

hs_fp_range.meaning: d_i and d_e axis range of the fingerprint plots (bins of 0.01 A from hirshfeld_xray/*_fingerprint.npz)

hs_opacity.meaning: opacity of the d_norm surface (1 = opaque; translucent surfaces showed depth-peeling artefacts on the Pi renderer)

hs_fp_rebin.meaning: fingerprint bins merged 2 x 2 (0.01 A bins of the npz -> 0.02 A)

elf_atom_tol.meaning: atoms within this distance of an ELF/LOL plane are drawn and labelled (SI ELF/LOL figure)

dock_pocket_cut.meaning: pocket residues drawn in the docking renders: any heavy atom within this distance of a drawn ligand (Fig. 9a, 9b)

rdg_xlim.meaning: sign(lambda2)rho window of the SI RDG scatter plots (includes the N1-H1A...O5 spike at facts nci.pcm.hb_spike)

rdg_ymax.meaning: RDG upper limit of the SI RDG scatter plots

ir_fwhm.meaning: FWHM of the Lorentzian bands of the SI IR spectrum

hs_decomp_min.meaning: contact types with at least this share of the surface get a decomposed fingerprint panel (SI Hirshfeld decomposition)

hs_fp_bin.meaning: bin width of the plotted fingerprint plots (0.01 A npz bins merged 2 x 2, PARAM hs_fp_rebin)

dock_bb_cut.meaning: docking renders: backbone N, C, O of a pocket residue drawn only when its N or O is within this distance of a ligand

dock_polar_max.meaning: interaction maps (Fig. 10 right): receptor N/O ... ligand N/O pairs drawn when at most this far apart (geometric criterion; distances from dock/results/production_contacts.json)

dock_contact_cut.meaning: contact cutoff of dock/contacts.py (residues_within_4A) quoted in the Fig. 10 caption (protocol value, dock/RESULTS.md section 4)

dock_gate_rmsd.meaning: gate G2 top-pose RMSD threshold (PLAN.md P3; dock/VALIDATION.md section 4), drawn in the SI seed figure and quoted in captions

dock_crit_2A.meaning: conventional 2.0 A redocking criterion (dock/VALIDATION.md section 4), quoted in captions

dock_ca_n.meaning: C-alpha atoms in the 6RL9/3HS4 superposition that carries the cross-docking references (production_summary.json rmsd_to_crystal n_ca_atoms; its RMSD is facts dock.val.ca_rmsd_6RL9_3HS4)

dock_label_cut.meaning: docking renders: residues with a heavy atom within this distance of a drawn ligand are named (farther ones are drawn unlabelled)
